title: Long resumed projections exceed argv or provider context limits

locators: fault-successor-development-20261008/dispatch/runs/aka_row_gather/run-evidence: event275 native compacting then invalid_request Prompt is too long

observation: The complete task projection was passed as one process argument. Linux refused its growth with Errno7 before provider startup. Separately Row Gather attempted native compaction and returned Prompt is too long; that is not the OS argument limit. Prior modelUsage aggregates multiple calls and cannot identify one request's token count.
proposed_change: Opt-in v7 keeps exact-file permissions and unchanged task projection bytes, moves the actual prompt to supervised stdin through the isolated credential shim, and pins native compaction at100k to reserve room for the next projection. Legacy protocols retain argv transport. New wrappers need fresh initial/resume qualification. Earlier compaction is a bounded mitigation, not proof against every future context overflow.
promotion_disposition: Lab transport/context policy. No Compiler semantics, old Run reclassification or automatic failed-Run retry.
